name: Additive anticholinergic burden
actions: Review total anticholinergic burden when combining agents with anticholinergic effects.
Monitor for dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, urinary retention, confusion, and cognitive impairment.
Use additional caution in older adults and in patients with glaucoma, constipation, urinary retention, or cognitive vulnerability.

rationale: Both drugs contribute clinically meaningful anticholinergic effects.
Combined anticholinergic burden may increase peripheral and central adverse effects.

explanation_template: {A_name} and {B_name} both contribute anticholinergic effects. Combined use may increase anticholinergic adverse-effect burden (educational).

references.citation: PD stacking: overlapping anticholinergic effects can increase anticholinergic burden.
